name: Salmon
quote: The hunt begins. Enjoy this carnival of slaughter.

voices.label: Good Morning
voices.text: A good day starts with breakfast, so here's a cup of hot tea, Professor. Here, I'll pour it for you... Oh dear, the cup broke... I suppose it can't be helped; after all, only one of my hands functions as normal. Surely you won't hold a "tiny mistake" like this against me, will you, Professor? Especially when the Oasis has so many cups... Of course, if anything needs cutting, feel free to call me at any time. That is, if you don't mind the smell of machine oil and rust on my hands, hehe...

voices.label: Good Afternoon
voices.text: Hmm... It's time for my afternoon nap. As you know, I'm not one for working in the daytime; I typically always operate at night. By the way, Professor, I must advise you to avoid coming near me while I am asleep. There is a saying which goes, "I like killing people in my dreams", and if I fall asleep, you might end up... Hehe, that was just a joke. I'm not in the habit of sleepwalking, after all.

voices.label: Good Evening
voices.text: How about having dinner with me, Professor? Let's see what's for dinner... Urgh. You... are those vegetables on your plate? How could something with such low calories and high fiber content possibly be present there?! Any chef who mixes vegetables in with meat stew ought to be crushed into pot metal by a hydraulic press! Ahhhh, and you're enjoying it too... no no no, this can't be happening...

voices.label: Good Night
voices.text: I'm back... Huh, you're not asleep yet? Well, I just finished hunting, so I probably reek of Liquid Entropy and rust. I'd better go take a bath first. As for your invitation to supper, I'll have to take a rain check... huh? I don't need to work so hard? Are you sure you aren't mistaken, Professor? I'm not fighting because I'm ordered to. Killing things is an instinct embedded into my neural cloud. The leash is in your hands, so feel free to rein me in if you think it's dangerous, Pro-fes-sor~

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 1
voices.text: Hahahaha, I can't believe you didn't recognize me even though I brushed past you... Wait a minute, did you mistake me for someone else just because I put on a pair of glasses? How should I put this... The truth is, I don't like wearing any accessories on my face. In the past, the test subjects at Ultilife were all terrified of me and putting on glasses was just a way to hide my bloodlust. However, I'll take them off if it means you can't recognize me.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 2
voices.text: Let me make this clear; I am not a shallow person. Rather than an ever-shifting projection, I prefer what's "inside" that is unique to each Doll. Hehe... It's not quite like that which you think of as a soul. I, for one, deeply enjoy Doll spines. If you lined up the spines from every single Doll model, I could accurately tell you which one they belonged to, their length of service, and even their various special characteristics. I suppose that's one of my few strengths.

voices.label: Main Interface Voice 3
voices.text: ...Aren't you being a little careless? Is it alright to show your weaknesses to me like that? I could easily snap your neck... Oh my, are you awake, Professor? It's nothing, I was just attracted to your adorable sleeping face, so I leaned in to take a look. I hope I didn't disturb your slumber, hehehe...

voices.label: Home Screen 5
voices.text: Oh my~ This won't do at all, this volume is far too intense for you; not for Professors, in other words. The visceral scenes in here will surely give you nightmares, so I would advise that you restrain your curiosity for the sake of your physical and mental health, hehe.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 1
voices.text: Mwehehehe...

voices.label: Interactive Voice 2
voices.text: What a "dangerous" game you're playing.

voices.label: Interactive Voice 3
voices.text: You have no idea how charming you are, do you...

voices.label: On Duty
voices.text: Don't worry and just leave it all to me, hehe...

voices.label: Obtain
voices.text: Nice to meet you, Professor. I am Salmon. May I touch your spine? I'll be gentle and make sure not to snap it.

voices.label: Potential Breakthrough
voices.text: I haven't felt this ecstasy in so long...

voices.label: Neural Expansion
voices.text: Carnival time!

voices.label: Max Rank
voices.text: Fear me, for I am your nightmare.

voices.label: Join Team
voices.text: Finally, time to have fun.

voices.label: Battle Start
voices.text: The hunt begins.

voices.label: Ultimate Skill
voices.text: A baptism of slaughter!

voices.label: MVP 1
voices.text: It's not enough, it's nowhere near enough...

voices.label: MVP 2
voices.text: My most beloved trophies are yours.

voices.label: Defeat
voices.text: ...Impossible...

voices.label: Oath
voices.text:
You really are bold to choose me as your oath partner, Professor. Are you ready for this? From this day forth, our vertebrae shall be interlinked, your flesh will irrigate my steel, and your bones shall bleach in the wastes along with my rusted frame.
I believe this must be the first time you've heard such a wild oath, no? It might sound scary, but that's how it is to me. While I was not born on the same day as you, I do wish to be buried beside you, to shelter your body from the elements with my own. In deference to my loyalty, I hope you will forgive my killings and desires, and permit my wicked soul to be entwined with yours. So never let go of my leash; is that alright, Professor?

voices.label: New Year
voices.text: I got you a New Year's gift like the other Dolls. Want to know what it is? Then open it and see... Hehe, it's a necklace made of Doll finger bearings. The ones decorating it come from 15 different Doll models. Such a memorable gift, don't you think? Go on and take it, Professor! ~Oho, just look at your face. Hehe, you're as adorable as ever. The truth is, I just made all that up. These aren't finger bearings or anything; they're just made out of a special alloy. Does that put you at ease now? Urgh... Don't refuse it, Professor... it'll make me cry, boohoo...

voices.label: Valentine's Day
voices.text: Have some chocolate, Professor! This is a special freebie for Valentine's Day! Allow me to demonstrate the art of slicing chocolate into squares with my bare hands! Ehhh!? It's not entertaining, you say... Don't go raining on my parade now, Professor. Then I'll carve "Along The River During The Qingming Festival" into the chocolate. Hehe... Crap, the chocolate broke...

voices.label: Tanabata
voices.text:
Tanabata? Is that a special occasion?
...Ah, it's where you pray for a wise heart and nimble hands. Oh, I see. Then I'll need to pay close attention to it. A nimble pair of hands are tools for performing the best killings, so since festivals like this which allow me to improve my skills don't come by often, I can't miss out on it~

voices.label: Halloween
voices.text: I'm not interested in going around in costume. Openly demanding candy from you is much more fun. Hm? Adults don't get candy? Then why don't I trade you some of the sweets I made? I have thumb cookies, eyeball jawbreakers and everyone's favorite, white chocolate vertebrae. Looks just like the real thing, doesn't it~ Looks like modelling it after the real thing paid off after all!

voices.label: Christmas
voices.text: Merry Christmas, Professor. I made a cake for you, and here's a slice... Hehe, it's quite an honor to receive your praise for the very first dessert I made. In the past, I was used to cutting things up, so creating something new by putting things together is a new thing for me, especially since the softness of cakes is quite different from the icy cold hardness of machines. All in all, it was a good experience. Won't you have more? You might not get a second chance.

voices.label: Birthday Wish
voices.text: Professor, congratulations on becoming a year older. Today is a special day, so I shall make an exception and give you an opportunity to make a wish to me that I will grant, no matter what it is. For instance, I could destroy your enemies or give some gentle discipline to some habitually disobedient Dolls, or perhaps... In any case, I hope you will be able to spend this day in happiness. Oh? You really don't want to make one? (Sigh) It seems I shall be a useless pile of scrap today as well.

voices.label: Neural Cloud
voices.text: Neural Cloud

voices.label: Intimacy 1
voices.text: I heard you received quite a lot of complaints about me recently... It must have been tough. I can't help but want to tease those cute little brats on the street whenever I see them. In truth, it's not as though I did anything too overboard; I simply told them about my experiences at Ultilife. But before I could finish, they'd run off crying and screaming. (Sigh) It would be one thing if we were on the battlefield and I could channel my energy into other avenues, but the Oasis is so peaceful... I will do my best to mind my behavior in the future and minimize any inconvenience to you.

voices.label: Intimacy 2
voices.text: Oh? Thanks for bringing my nametag over... No, there's no need to doubt me, the person in the picture is definitely me. Honestly, Professor, you're always like this, it's as though you can't recognize me the moment I put my glasses on. By the way, I don't have any visual defects which need correction. The glasses are simply to suppress my killing intent and make it easier to approach others. After all, going around with a scowl on my face would only spook my prey. However, that doesn't seem to work too well on you, Professor... I wonder why, hehe. After all, you've never been afraid of me...

voices.label: Intimacy 3
voices.text: Pardon me, I ought to be dressed. I hope my scars haven't put you off. Someone once reminded me to get my scars taken care of. But you see, each scar represents a sweet memory for me, so it's hard to let them go. For instance, this one here. I got it when one of the test subjects I was chasing sprang a trap on me and shoved my arm into a rotary saw. Ah, the pain is still fresh in my mind. And the ones here, by my ribs, those were from when one of the test subjects shanked me a few times. Still, there's no need to worry, those poor lost lambs got their just desserts. Would you like to see their scapulae, Professor? They're very pretty.

voices.label: Intimacy 4
voices.text: You want to read my notebook? Tut tut, I told you, it's not for Professors. It seems you've reached your rebellious phase. In that case, prepare yourself then, lest you be spooked... There we go... Hehe, was it truly that strange? No detailed drawings of corpses or grisly kills there, only simple sketches. Did you truly think that I would commit the fates of my prey to paper? The blackest hatred and most passionate love stem from the same source, and they must be inscribed into the depths of your neural cloud, one stroke at a time. So, Professor, with love and hate warring for possession of my soul, which do you think is closer to winning?

voices.label: Intimacy 5
voices.text:
Now that I think about it, I haven't gone out "hunting" for a while now. Hehehe, I hope my laziness doesn't displease you. After all, I need to keep a close eye on you and look for a chance to slit your throat with my Mistelteinn. But thanks to the Dolls watching you around the clock, I haven't had any chances to do that at all.
...So you already saw through me. Well, it's true that I had several chances in the past, but I decided not to follow through after careful though. After all, killing you would only give me a moment's enjoyment, which is nothing compared to the surprises that you constantly inflict on me by living. Hehe, good thing I didn't strike back then. How fortunate, how fortunate.

career:
The UL-Security is a medical bodyguard Doll developed by Ultilife. Compared to other Ultilife Dolls, the UL-Security is not equipped with any medical equipment or modules; instead, it is furnished with a high-output power source and combat gear derived from repurposed medical equipment. Officially published data indicates that the UL-Security has comparable performance to Universal Anything's Bodyguard series as well as a certain degree of medical knowledge, allowing it to be used as a makeshift nurse Doll when needed.

The UL-Security was never put on sale and served only in Ultilife's security division. At Ultilife's recommendation, the UL-Security known as "Salmon" was selected for Project Neural Cloud at the end of 2059.
infoStories:
Ultilife developed the UL-Security medical bodyguard Doll in order to safeguard medical personnel and medical-type Dolls during unstable or violent situations. Unlike Universal Anything's Bodyguard or Security 2.0 series, which are intended for civilian use, the UL-Security employs military-grade technology. Its custom-made endoskeleton far exceeds the output requirements needed for security duties, and its specialized combat modules make the UL-Security's form factor appear excessively muscular and bulky compared to most civilian Dolls. When its various combat modules are all factored in, the UL-Security possesses an aggressiveness and threatening air that is unsuited for a medical environment, a fact that has sparked much debate and conjecture over its true purpose.

Naturally, public discourse surrounding the UL-Security does not merely revolve around its appearance and equipment, and suspicions about Ultilife itself are still ongoing. It has been pointed out that the UL-Security seems to have stolen some Svarog Heavy Industries technologies and it has even been suspected that the UL-Security itself was made for combat operations of some kind. However, Ultilife has never addressed such allegations.

Although the UL-Security project has been public knowledge for a long time now, the exact details and nature of it remain a mystery. Few people know how many UL-Security units are in service, their detailed performance parameters, their costs and the places in which they are deployed. The only known record of UL-Security data comes from the unit designated as "Salmon", left behind when he joined Project Neural Cloud.

While Salmon was vague about the UL-Security's specifics during his entrance interview and he did not fully comply with 42Lab's requirements for project candidates, the value of having a UL-Security as a specimen merited further consideration of his case. After discussion with multiple parties, 42Lab finally permitted Salmon to join the project.

"Hm? A medical bodyguard Doll? No no no... My job is way more dangerous. Let me think... Well, calling me an executioner would be a bit inaccurate... In that case... What do you think about "specimen guardian"? Would that be better?"

—From the UL-Security interview log.

[Ultilife "Department 7" Investigation Report]
"Department 7" is a Doll development think-tank under Ultilife, but it possesses a great deal of latitude in terms of budgeting and staffing. On the surface, "Department 7" is responsible for creating tactile feedback systems used in surgeon Dolls, but in truth, it holds many Dolls designed as test subjects for medical experiments in order to replicate human illnesses. "Department 7" was briefly shuttered after the "Silver Fire" incident exposed it, but it has still been operating in secret even as late as 2060.

Pictures from an informed source have confirmed that "Department 7" operates UL-Security Dolls, who are used as watchmen for test subjects. Their neural cloud settings seem completely devoid of empathy, pity and various positive personality traits; not only are they cruel and ruthless, they seem to take pleasure in slaughtering Dolls during executions. However, it is said that certain UL-Security Dolls were secretly destroyed due to deliberately misplacing a valuable UL-SD specimen after the "Silver Fire" incident, although the evidence for that is unreliable.

The whistleblower for this information went missing in November 2060. All investigation into this case has been terminated and all records have been sealed.

According to Arcadia's records, Salmon was one of the first Dolls to join the Guardians after the Wipe-off Incident. Salmon did not seem particularly displeased by being trapped on the cloud server. On the contrary, he deeply enjoyed the carnage on the cloud. Here, he was no longer bound by his code and could freely indulge in the joy of slaughter without having to obey orders. He was absorbed in "N" and served as one of the strongest fighters of the Guardians.

However, Salmon's actions and his habits made most of the Guardians avoid him, with even Sangoma being wary of him. Meanwhile, De Lacey and Lind, who joined "N" around the same time as Salmon, had an even worse relationship with him. The former tried to rein in Salmon's radical actions many times, while the latter seemed to have some knowledge of him from reality.

After the Oasis began working with Arcadia, Salmon came to the Oasis as a representative of "N" from the Guardians. Upon learning this, the Guardians began highlighting numerous things that the Professor ought to know about their comrade. Even De Lacey and Lind took the time to give the Professor warnings about him. In fact, they wanted to personally visit the Oasis to protect them.

The Oasis went out of its way to assign several Dolls to the Professor as a bodyguard detail just in case anything happened. However, things went surprisingly well and Salmon made no threatening moves at all. In fact, he was remarkably well-mannered and polite. However, this did not imply that Salmon had no interest in the Professor. On the contrary, once the meeting was over, he immediately applied to be stationed at the Oasis as a liaison. After considering that Salmon did not seem to bear any ill-will to the Professor, the Exiles and the Guardians approved the secondment request, but their caution toward Salmon and the extra protective detail for the Professor has not been revoked to date.
oathDesc: The most primal naivete, only for you.

Attire produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea. These are the clothes they are most comfortable in.
"You would choose me to protect you? A dangerous challenge, for both you and I... hehehe..."

projections.desc:
Attire and environment produced with Neural Cloud Projection upon a Doll's arrival in Magrasea, which mirrors their life in the real world.
"Ah... hah... This feeling is truly impossible to let go of. Professor, where shall we hunt next?"
